scientific_question: Does the frozen CMI repository pass its official unit/integration tests and produce complete byte-stable deterministic smoke scores on its released validated Causal-LoCoMo-with-history artifact without API or GPU access?
estimand: Technical reproducibility and deterministic score stability; no performance claim is estimated at this stage.
procedures: Run the complete official pytest suite once.
Run the official dataset validator on all 87 released records.
Run src.experiments.run_experiment twice with config/default.yaml, --dry_run, --max_examples 5, --skip_llm_judge, --deterministic_only, and --no_cache.
Each smoke attempt must emit 35 predictions and 35 scores: five examples by seven methods, with zero failed rows.
The two scores.jsonl files must be byte-identical. Timing-bearing prediction and aggregate artifacts are retained but are not required to be byte-identical.
allowed_surfaces: local deterministic scorers and generated paper artifacts exercised by tests
acceptance_rule: ACCEPT only if pytest exits zero, dataset validation reports 87 valid and 0 errors, each attempt emits exactly 35 predictions and 35 scores with 0 failures, scores.jsonl is byte-identical across attempts, all evidence hashes verify, and no container remains.
